entry_signal: At each rebalance date, compute 4 signals for every sector ETF: (1) Momentum — 4-month rate of change, (2) EWMA Volatility — RiskMetrics-style exponentially weighted vol (lambda=0.94), (3) Average Pairwise Correlation — mean correlation of each sector vs all others over 84-day window, (4) ATR Trend/Breakout — price vs ATR-based upper/lower bands. Rank each signal across sectors (lower rank = better: high momentum, low vol, low corr, uptrend). Composite score R = weighted sum of ranks. Select top-N sectors by lowest R. Regime-adaptive top-N: Bull (SPY > 200-SMA and breadth > 60%) → top_n+3; Neutral → top_n; Bear (SPY < 200-SMA) → top_n-2. Weight selected sectors equally or by inverse volatility.
exit_signal: At rebalance: sectors falling out of top-N are sold. In neutral/bear regimes, a cash filter replaces any selected sector with negative absolute momentum with SHY (cash). In bear regime, cash filter is always active.

parameter_ranges.signal_weights_MVCT: grid of 6 combinations (equal, momentum-heavy, vol-heavy, etc.)

hidden_params: exact ATR smoothing method (simple moving average vs Wilder)
